rationale: Whether to accept or decline an automated-review finding changes the code that ships, so a person decides every case (ADR-003 Invariant 6). The policy is initialized with full authority and exists to record the decision as an episode, not to learn to make it. Declared in Story 36.5 (ADR-036 section 4.5); the shape is not a policy until the maintainer runs task-policy-init.
